thought.text: The installation is locked. The systemd path unit should now trigger the completion service (start the daemon, remove the temporary unit). Since the shim tracks the path state, let me trigger it:

reasoning_content:
The installation is complete:
- `installed.lock` has been created
- The bootstrap user has been deleted (database-bootstrap.conf is gone)
- QisutuConfig.pm has been written

Next, I need to do the "temporäre Abschlussdienste (temporary completion services)" — the path unit is supposed to detect the lock and start the daemon. In my shim, I need to manually run the oneshot (simulating what systemd's path unit would do). This will:
1. Enable and start qisutu-daemon.service
2. Delete the temporary units

Let me run the equivalent of the install-complete oneshot via my shim.

action.command: systemctl enable --now qisutu-install-complete.path 2>&1; cat /run/qisutu/systemctl.state 2>/dev/null; echo "--- triggering oneshot (what the path unit would trigger) ---"; systemctl start qisutu-install-complete.service; echo "EXIT=$?"; echo "--- resulting state ---"; ls -la /etc/systemd/system/ | grep -i qisutu; echo "--- daemon running? ---"; ps aux | grep -v grep | grep qisutu-daemon | head -3; cat /run/qisutu/qisutu.pid 2>/dev/null && kill -0 $(cat /run/qisutu/qisutu.pid) && echo "DAEMON ALIVE"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "systemctl enable --now qisutu-install-complete.path 2>&1; cat /run/qisutu/systemctl.state 2>/dev/null; echo \"--- triggering oneshot (what the path unit would trigger) ---\"; systemctl start qisutu-install-complete.service; echo \"EXIT=$?\"; echo \"--- resulting state ---\"; ls -la /etc/systemd/system/ | grep -i qisutu; echo \"--- daemon running? ---\"; ps aux | grep -v grep | grep qisutu-daemon | head -3; cat /run/qisutu/qisutu.pid 2>/dev/null && kill -0 $(cat /run/qisutu/qisutu.pid) && echo \"DAEMON ALIVE\"", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Trigger install-complete oneshot and verify daemon"}

summary: Trigger install-complete oneshot and verify daemon
